batch: Joseph cycle (Gen 37-50), passages cast by scene / operation-web

units.characteristics: the favoured son; the bad report; the dreams; hatred and jealousy
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Joseph the favoured son brings a BAD (ra) REPORT (dibbah, slander); the brothers HATE (sane 37:4,5,8) him, cannot speak PEACEFULLY (shalom); the dreams (the sheaves, sun/moon) - 'will you RULE (mashal 37:8) over us?'; JEALOUS (qana 37:11), but the father KEPT (shamar) the saying - favour, dreams, and the hatred/jealousy they breed

units.characteristics: the plot to kill; sold into Egypt; the father's inconsolable grief
units.gist: NARRATIVE - sent to SEEK (shaal/baqash 37:15-16) the brothers; the plot - the FIERCE animal (chayyah/ra), 'let us not take his LIFE (nephesh 37:21)'; Reuben/Judah; sold; 'he is our FLESH (basar 37:27)'; the bloodied coat; Jacob MOURNS (aval/avel 37:34-35), refuses COMFORT (nacham), WEEPS (bakhah) - the selling and the father's inconsolable grief

units.characteristics: Judah and Tamar; withheld levirate; the disguise; she is more righteous
units.gist: NARRATIVE/INTERLUDE - Judah's sons NAMED (qara 38:3-5); Onan KNOWS (yada) the seed not his, WASTES (shachat) it, evil (raa 38:10); Tamar widowed, GROWS (gadal); disguised as a PROSTITUTE (zanah 38:15), Judah THINKS (chashav) her one; the pledge GIVEN (natan); the immorality (zenunim/zanah) charged - then 'she is more RIGHTEOUS (tsadeq 38:26) than I', he KNEW (yada) her not again - Judah shamed into righteousness by the wronged woman

units.characteristics: integrity in Potiphar's house; how can I sin against God; the false charge; the LORD in prison
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Joseph finds FAVOR (chen 39:4), ATTENDS (sharat); the LORD BLESSES (barakh/berakhah 39:5) the house for his sake; the temptation refused - 'how could I do this great WICKEDNESS (raah) and SIN (chata 39:9) against God'; won't LISTEN (shama 39:10); the false CRY (qara 39:14-18), the garment; Potiphar's anger KINDLED (charah 39:19); prison - but the LORD showed STEADFAST LOVE (chesed 39:21), favour, GAVE - integrity, the false charge, and God's presence in the pit

units.characteristics: the cupbearer and baker; the dreams interpreted; remember me; forgotten
units.gist: NARRATIVE - the officers OFFEND (chata 40:1), Pharaoh ANGRY (qatsaph 40:2); Joseph ATTENDS (sharat), sees them TROUBLED (zaaph)/DOWNCAST (ra 40:6-7); the dreams interpreted ('interpretations belong to God'); 'show me KINDNESS (chesed 40:14), REMEMBER (zakhar) me, deal WELL (yatav)' - but the cupbearer did not REMEMBER (zakhar 40:23), forgot him - interpretation as gift, and the forgetting

units.characteristics: Pharaoh's dreams; the wise men fail; God will give the answer; the discerning interpretation
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Pharaoh's dreams (the FAT/thin cows, basar; GOOD/blighted ears, tov/ra); the WISE MEN (chakham 41:8) fail; the cupbearer REMEMBERS (zakhar 41:9); Joseph CALLED (qara 41:14) - 'not I; God will give a FAVOURABLE (shalom 41:16) answer'; the interpretation (seven plenty, seven famine); 'let Pharaoh find a WISE (chakham) and DISCERNING (bin 41:33) man' - the dream read, the counsel given

units.characteristics: Joseph exalted over Egypt; wise and discerning; the sons named; the famine begins
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Pharaoh PLEASED (yatav 41:37): 'God has SHOWN (yada 41:39) you this, none so DISCERNING (bin)'; Joseph set over Egypt (gadal/rum 41:40-44); the ABUNDANCE (ravah 41:49) gathered; the sons NAMED - Manasseh ('God made me forget my HARDSHIP', amal 41:51), Ephraim ('fruitful in the land of my AFFLICTION', oni 41:52); the famine SEVERE (chazaq 41:56-57) over all the earth - exaltation, the naming that reframes the pain, the famine

units.characteristics: the brothers' first descent; roughness and testing; the guilt surfaces; Joseph weeps secretly
units.gist: NARRATIVE - the brothers come to buy grain that they may LIVE (chayah 42:2); Joseph GOVERNOR (shallit), speaks ROUGHLY (qasheh 42:7), REMEMBERS (zakhar 42:9) his dreams; the test (by the LIFE/chay of Pharaoh, TRUTH emet 42:15-16); 'we are GUILTY (ashem) concerning our brother... his SOUL (nephesh) in DISTRESS (tsarah) when he BEGGED (chanan 42:21)'; Reuben - 'did I not say do not SIN (chata 42:22)?'; Joseph turns and WEEPS (bakhah 42:24); the money returned; TREMBLING HEARTS (charad/lev 42:28); Jacob's refusal, FEAR (yare)/SORROW (yagon 42:38) - the buried guilt surfacing, Joseph's hidden weeping

units.characteristics: Judah's surety; Benjamin brought; the meal; Joseph's compassion overflows
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Judah's SURETY (ud/baqash 43:8-9, 'let me bear the BLAME/chata forever'); 'God Almighty grant you MERCY (rachamim 43:14)'; the steward - 'PEACE (shalom 43:23), do not FEAR (yare), your God gave you treasure'; Joseph sees Benjamin - 'God be GRACIOUS (chanan 43:29) to you'; his COMPASSION (rachamim 43:30) YEARNS, he WEEPS (bakhah); the meal, the Egyptians' ABOMINATION (toevah 43:32); the brothers in AMAZEMENT (tamah 43:33) - surety, mercy, and compassion barely held back

units.characteristics: the planted cup; the test; Judah's plea; the substitute offered
units.gist: THE TEST/GEM - the cup planted, 'why have you returned EVIL (raah/raa 44:4-5)?'; 'God has found out our GUILT (avon 44:16)'; Judah's great plea (BURNS not, charah 44:18) - the father's LIFE (nephesh 44:30) bound in the lad's, the SORROW (yagon 44:31) that would kill him, 'I became SURETY... let me bear the BLAME (chata 44:32)'; Judah OFFERS HIMSELF for Benjamin - the substitute; Judah's transformation complete (contrast selling Joseph)

units.characteristics: I am Joseph; do not be distressed, God sent me; the providence reading; Jacob revived
units.gist: GEM - 'I am Joseph' (KNOWN/yada, CRIED/qara, WEPT/bakhah 45:1-2); the brothers DISMAYED (bahal 45:3); 'do not be ANGRY (charah) with yourselves - God sent me to PRESERVE LIFE (michyah 45:5), to keep you ALIVE (chayah 45:7)'; not you but God made me RULER (mashal 45:8); the weeping and kissing (bakhah 45:14-15); Pharaoh PLEASED, the gifts (natan, PITY/chus 45:20); 'do not QUARREL (ragaz 45:24)'; Jacob's heart FAINTED then REVIVED (aman/lev/chayah 45:26-27) - the disclosure, the first providence-reading, the father revived

units.characteristics: God's fear-not; the descent; the reunion; settling in Goshen
units.gist: NARRATIVE - God: 'do not be AFRAID (yare 46:3) to go down; I will go with you and bring you up'; the house of Jacob (the census - PERSONS/nephesh, thin genealogy 46:8-27); Joseph MEETS (qara 46:29) his father, WEEPS (bakhah) long; 'now let me DIE, you are ALIVE (chay 46:30)'; the Goshen plan (the shepherds an ABOMINATION/toevah 46:34 to Egypt) - God's reassurance, the reunion, the settling apart

units.characteristics: Jacob blesses Pharaoh; few and evil my days; the famine administration; the burial-oath
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Jacob BLESSES (barakh 47:7,10) Pharaoh; 'few and EVIL have been the days of my LIFE (chayyim 47:9)'; the famine SEVERE (chazaq 47:20) - Egypt sells land/selves for grain, 'you have SAVED our LIVES (chayah 47:25), let us find FAVOUR (chen)'; Israel MULTIPLIES (ravah 47:27) in Goshen; Jacob's oath - deal in STEADFAST LOVE (chesed 47:29) and TRUTH (emet), bury me with my fathers - blessing, provision, and the pull toward the land

units.characteristics: Jacob blesses Joseph's sons; the crossed hands; the younger over the elder
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Jacob STRENGTHENS (chazaq 48:2) himself; 'God Almighty BLESSED (barakh 48:3) me... will MULTIPLY (ravah)'; adopts Ephraim and Manasseh; 'the angel who REDEEMED me BLESS (barakh 48:16) the boys'; the crossed hands - the younger over the elder (Joseph DISPLEASED/raa, tries to MOVE/sur 48:17); 'I KNOW (yada 48:19), the younger shall be GREATER (gadal)' - the blessing, the inversion again (the family pattern)

units.characteristics: the blessing of the twelve; the deferred reckonings; Judah's ascendancy; Joseph's blessings
units.gist: GEM - Jacob CALLS (qara 49:1) the sons; Reuben - 'UNSTABLE (pachaz 49:4) as water', the firstborn's forfeit; Simeon & Levi - 'CURSED (arar 49:7) be their anger, for it is FIERCE (ezuz)' (the Shechem reckoning LANDS); Judah - PRAISE (yadah 49:8), the scepter, OBEDIENCE (49:10) of the peoples; 'I WAIT (qavah) for your SALVATION (yeshuah 49:18)'; Joseph - ATTACKED (marar/satam 49:23) yet UNMOVED (etan 49:24), BLESSINGS (berakhah 49:25-26) heaped - the deathbed oracles, the reckonings deferred from JAC-17/18 now spoken

units.characteristics: Jacob's charge and death; Joseph weeps; the great mourning; buried in Canaan
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Jacob charges the burial in Machpelah, gathers his feet, dies; Joseph falls on his face and WEEPS (bakhah 50:1), the embalming, Egypt WEEPS (bakhah 50:3); the great MOURNING (evel/mispad/saphad 50:10) at the threshing floor; buried in the cave with his fathers - the patriarch's death, Joseph's grief, the return of the body to the land

units.characteristics: the brothers' fear; you meant evil God meant good; comfort; Joseph's death and bones-oath
units.gist: GEM - the father dead, the brothers FEAR 'Joseph will HATE (satam 50:15) us', beg forgiveness of the TRANSGRESSION (pesha)/SIN (chattat 50:17), WEEP (bakhah); Joseph - 'do not FEAR (yare 50:19); am I in the place of God? you MEANT (chashav 50:20) EVIL (raah) against me, but God MEANT it for good, to keep many people ALIVE (chayah)'; he COMFORTS (nacham) them, speaks to their HEART (lev 50:21); Joseph's death, LIVED (chayah) 110, the bones-oath ('God will surely visit you') - the climactic providence-reading, forgiveness, and hope carried in bones
